notes.title: Retiring CAD XR
notes.content: Due to no longer being able to provide support for this product, we are removing CAD XR from Steam. Thank you all for the support and we hope you enjoyed CAD XR!

notes.title: CAD XR - Features & Requests
notes.content:
Hi All,

Thanks to everyone who's purchased CAD XR! We're excited to have shared this program with you and want it to continue helping users effectively visualize CAD models and projects. 

We'd love your feedback. Send us your thoughts about CAD XR, whether there's something about it that you really liked, something that could have been better executed, or if you have a feature you want to request for upcoming versions. We're open to any and all suggestions.

Thanks!
The Lucid Sight Team
